map.营销 ROI=(收入−营销投入)÷营销投入；ROAS=收入÷广告投入。叠加复购时: Marketing ROI = (revenue − marketing spend) / marketing spend; ROAS = revenue / ad spend. With repeat purchase included, total revenue = first-order conversions × average order value + repeat orders × average order value. For multiple channels, account for organic and paid traffic separately to avoid over- or under-stating a single channel's contribution.

CPC = marketing spend ÷ clicks, CPA = marketing spend ÷ conversions, CPM = marketing spend ÷ impressions × 1000; funnel bar width = that layer's value ÷ impressions × 100% (minimum 8%)

map.ROI 和 ROAS 区别？: How do ROI and ROAS differ?
map.ROAS 只看收入/广告费；ROI 扣成本看盈利。注意本页 ROI 只扣营销投入: ROAS only looks at revenue / ad spend, while ROI deducts cost to show profit. Note that this page's ROI deducts marketing spend only, not product cost, so ROI% = (ROAS−1)×100% and ROI>0 is always equivalent to ROAS>1; "negative ROI with ROAS above 1" cannot happen here. Only MROI, which includes product cost, can diverge from ROAS.
